
```{r}
group_labels <- c("epiBmpr1aKO uninfected" = "Bmpr1a KO","epiBmpr1aWT uninfected"="Bmpr1a WT","Stromal IL1r1 WT Hpy 2m inf"="H.pylori 2m","Stromal IL1r1 WT uninfected"= "Uninfected")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
m = table(scData.combined$cluster_label |> droplevels(), scData.combined$orig.ident)
mm_r <- prop.table(m, margin=2)

mm_rel_ts = reshape2::melt(t(mm_r))
colnames(mm_rel_ts) = c("Sample","Cluster","Proportion_cells")
mm_rel_ts$Cluster = factor(paste0("",mm_rel_ts$Cluster))

tmp <- unique(scData.combined@meta.data[, c("orig.ident", "group_label")])
tmp$Sample_label <- paste0(tmp$group_label, " ", data.table::rowidv(tmp$group_label))
tmp <- tmp[order(tmp$group_label, tmp$Sample_label),]
tmp$Sample_label <- factor(tmp$Sample_label, levels=tmp$Sample_label)
mm_rel_ts <- merge(mm_rel_ts, tmp, by.y="orig.ident", by.x="Sample", all.x=T, sort=F)
mm_rel_ts$Experiment <- ifelse(mm_rel_ts$group_label %in% c("Uninfected","H.pylori 2m"), "Hpy infection", "Bmpr1a KO") |> factor(levels=c("Hpy infection","Bmpr1a KO"))


#cluster_order = sort(unique(mm_rel_ts$Cluster))
```

Science 17 Oct 2024 Vol 386, Issue 6719 pp. 341-348
DOI: 10.1126/science.adl146
The major EEC subtype, the enterochromaffin cell (EC), produces ~90% of the body’s serotonin (5-HT) and regulates gut motility and inflammation. The other EECs are coded with letters: L cells produce glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1), neurotensin (NTS), peptide YY (PYY), and cholecystokinin (CCK); MX cells produce ghrelin (GHRL) and motilin (MLN); D cells produce somatostatin (SST); K cells produce gastric inhibitory protein (GIP); and G cells produce gastrin (GAST) (3). K, MX, and G cells are most abundant in the proximal small intestine (SI), whereas L cells are enriched in the distal SI and colon. The stomach corpus contains an EEC subset called enterochromaffin-like (ECL) cells. In addition to producing some 5-HT, ECL cells produce histamine to regulate acid secretion by nearby parietal cells (4). Important differences exist between mouse and human EECs. For instance, human MX cells express motilin only in the SI but not in the stomach (where these are called X cells), whereas the pertinent gene is a pseudogene in rodents.

# Signatures on Epithelial cells - UCell

```{r, fig.width = 20, fig.height=12}
library(UCell)
library(GSEABase)
library(homologene)
library(msigdbr)

ee = msigdbr(category = "H", species = "mouse")

mouse_gs <- GSEABase:::getGmt("../../Data/External/GeneSets/mouse_custom_geneset_2026-04-24.gmt")
human_gs <- GSEABase:::getGmt("../../Data/External/GeneSets/human_custom_geneset_2026-04-24.gmt")

#gene_sets <- list()
gene_sets <- tapply(ee$gene_symbol, ee$gs_name, list)

sel_mouse_gs <- names(mouse_gs)
sel_mouse_gs <- sel_mouse_gs [!grepl("Mouse_colon_ref|AKP_", sel_mouse_gs)]

sel_human_gs <- names(human_gs)
sel_human_gs <- sel_human_gs [!grepl("Joanito|Cords|Gao_FB|Qi_CRC|Tissue_specific|Healthy_human_stomach", sel_human_gs)]

for (nn in sel_mouse_gs) {
  gene_sets[[make.names(nn)]] <- geneIds(mouse_gs[[nn]])   
}

for (nn in sel_human_gs) {
    gene_sets[[make.names(nn)]] <- geneIds(human_gs[[nn]]) |> homologene::human2mouse(db=homologene::homologeneData2) |> (\(x) x$mouseGene)()
}

set.seed(1234)
scData.combined <- UCell::AddModuleScore_UCell(scData.combined, features = gene_sets)
```

```{r}
tmp <- scData.combined@meta.data[, grepl("_UCell", colnames(scData.combined@meta.data))] |> as.matrix()
rownames(tmp) <- rownames(scData.combined@meta.data)
colnames(tmp) <- gsub("_UCell","", colnames(tmp))
r <- t(tmp)

```


```{r}
library(limma)
inp_mat <- r
sid <- scData.combined@meta.data[colnames(inp_mat),"orig.ident"]
cl <- scData.combined@meta.data[colnames(inp_mat),"cluster_label"]
group <- scData.combined@meta.data[colnames(inp_mat),"group_label"]

ed <- data.frame(sample=as.character(sid), g1 =group |> as.character() |> make.names()) |> unique()
rownames(ed) <- ed$sample

all_res <- list()

for (cc in unique(cl)) {
  r_agg <- limma::avearrays(inp_mat[,cl == cc], sid[cl==cc])

  library(limma)
  #design <- cbind(intercept=rep(1,ncol(r_agg)), group=ifelse(ed[colnames(r_agg),"g1"]=="AKP", 1, 0) )

  mm <- model.matrix(~g1+0, data = ed[match(colnames(r_agg), ed$sample),])
  
  fit <- lmFit(r_agg, design = mm)
  
  if(length(colnames(mm)) == 4) {
  cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(Bmpr1a_KO_vs_WT = g1Bmpr1a.KO - g1Bmpr1a.WT,
                              Hpy_vs_uninf =    g1H.pylori.2m - g1Uninfected,
                              levels=mm)
  } else {
    if( all(c("g1Bmpr1aKO","g1Bmpr1aWT") %in% colnames(mm)) ) {
        cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(Bmpr1a_KO_vs_WT = g1Bmpr1a.KO - g1epiBmpr1a.WT,
                              levels=mm)
    } else { 
      if( all(c("g1H.pylori.2m","g1Uninfected") %in% colnames(mm)) ) {
        cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(Hpy_vs_uninf =    g1H.pylori.2m - g1Uninfected,
                              levels=mm)
      } else {
        next;
      }
    }
  }
  
  
  fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

  for (nn in colnames(cont.matrix)) {
    res <- topTable(fit2, coef = nn, adjust="BH", number = nrow(r_agg))
    res$gs_name <- rownames(res)
    res$cluster <- cc
    res$comparison <- nn
    res$clust_comp <- paste0(cc, "__", nn)
    all_res[[paste0(cc, "__", nn)]] <- res[order(res$P.Value),]
  }

}


all_res_df <- do.call(rbind, all_res)
all_res_df$FDR.global  <- p.adjust(all_res_df$P.Value, method = "BH")
```

```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=6}
sel_genesets <- c("Gil_Vazquez_RSC_signature_mouse_UCell", "Yui_Fetal_vs_adult_up_UCell","Yui_DSS_colitis_vs_control_up_UCell", "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE_UCell","Gregorieff_Yap_KO_down_UCell","Gregorieff_Yap_Tg_up_UCell", "Lgr5_SC_Signature_Munoz_UCell", "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION_UCell","HALLMARK_FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM_UCell")

for (gs in sel_genesets) {
  gn <- gsub("_UCell","", gs)
  
  p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(x=group_label, fill=group_label, y = .data[[gs]])) + geom_boxplot() + 
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c( "Uninfected","H.pylori 2m"), c( "Bmpr1a WT", "Bmpr1a KO" )), method = "wilcox") + facet_wrap(~ cluster_label, ncol=11) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))
  print(p)
  
  tmp_agg <- tmp[, .(mean_score = mean(.SD[[gs]]) ), by=c("orig.ident", "group_label", "cluster_label")]
  tmp_agg$Experiment <- ifelse(tmp_agg$group_label %in% c("Uninfected","H.pylori 2m"), "Hpy infection", "Bmpr1a KO") |> factor(levels=c("Hpy infection","Bmpr1a KO"))
  
  de_gs <- subset(de, gs_name == gn)
  de_gs$Experiment <- ifelse(de_gs$comparison == "Bmpr1a_KO_vs_WT", "Bmpr1a KO", "Hpy infection")
  de_gs$sign <- ifelse(de_gs$adj.P.Val < 0.05, "*", "n.s.")
  de_gs$cluster_label <- factor(de_gs$cluster, levels=cluster_order)
  de_gs <- subset(de_gs, cluster_label %in% tmp_agg$cluster_label)
  de_gs$adjp <- prettyNum(de_gs$adj.P.Val, digits=3)
  de_gs$pval <- prettyNum(de_gs$P.Value, digits=3)
  de_gs$ypos <- max(tmp_agg$mean_score, na.rm=T) * 1.1

  p <- ggplot(tmp_agg, aes(x=group_label, col=group_label, y = mean_score)) + 
      #geom_boxplot() + 
      stat_summary(geom = "crossbar", fun = mean, width=0.5) + geom_point() +
      geom_text(data = de_gs, aes(x = 1.5, y = ypos, label = pval), inherit.aes = F) +
      facet_wrap(Experiment ~ cluster_label, ncol=14, scale = "free_x") + 
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) + 
      ggtitle(paste0("Average ",gn," UCell score per sample")) + labs(x="",  y= "Avg UCell score") 
  print(p )
  
  cairo_pdf(file.path(result_folder, paste0(gn, "_signature_UCell_v4.2.pdf")), width=20, height = 6, family="Arial")
  print(p)

dev.off()


}
```

```{r}
make_star_mat <- function(template_map, de_res, all_clusters, g1, g2, comp_suffix, p_thr = 0.05) {
  #stars <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(agg_mat), ncol = ncol(agg_mat),
#                dimnames = dimnames(agg_mat))
#stars[pval < 0.05] <- "*"
de_res_sel <- subset(de_res, GeneSymbol %in% rownames(template_map))
rownames(de_res_sel) <- NULL
de_res_sel$cluster <- gsub(paste0(comp_suffix,"$"),"", de_res_sel$comparison)
de_res_sel <- subset(de_res_sel, cluster %in% all_clusters)
missing_cl <- as.character(all_clusters[!all_clusters %in% unique(de_res_sel$cluster)])
if(!length(missing_cl)==0) {
  tmp_row <- de_res_sel[1, ,drop=F]
  tmp_row$padj = 1
  tmp_row$pvalue = 1
  tmp_row$log2FoldChange = NA
  for (cl in missing_cl) {
    tmp_row$cluster <- cl
    de_res_sel <- rbind(de_res_sel, tmp_row)
  }
}
de_res_sel$signif <- ifelse(de_res_sel$padj  <= p_thr, "*", "")
tmp <- reshape2::dcast(de_res_sel, GeneSymbol ~ cluster, value.var="signif")
de_res_star_mat <- as.matrix(tmp[, 2:ncol(tmp)])
rownames(de_res_star_mat) <- tmp$GeneSymbol
tmp2 <- de_res_star_mat
tmp2[tmp2!=""] <- ""
colnames(de_res_star_mat) <- paste0(g1,"_", colnames(de_res_star_mat))
colnames(tmp2) <- paste0(g2,"_", colnames(tmp2))
de_res_star_mat <- cbind(de_res_star_mat, tmp2)

de_res_star_mat <- de_res_star_mat[rownames(template_map), colnames(template_map)]
de_res_star_mat[is.na(de_res_star_mat)] <- ""
return(de_res_star_mat)
}
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
vln_with_p <- function(ds, gene, de_res, suffix, y_text = 3) {
  de_res_sel <- subset(de_res, GeneSymbol == gene)
  rownames(de_res_sel) <- NULL
  comp_suffix <- suffix
  de_res_sel$cluster <- gsub(paste0(comp_suffix,"$"),"", de_res_sel$comparison)
  de_res_sel$pval <- prettyNum(de_res_sel$pvalue, digits=3)
  de_res_sel$padj_t <- prettyNum(ifelse(is.na(de_res_sel$padj), 1, de_res_sel$padj), digits=3)
  #de_res_sel$ypos <- max(de_res_sel$baseMean, na.rm=T) * 1.1
  de_res_sel <- subset(de_res_sel, cluster %in% unique(ds$cluster_label))
  p1 <- VlnPlot(ds, features = gene, group.by="cluster_label", split.by="group_label", y.max = 3.1) + 
    geom_text(data = de_res_sel, aes(x = cluster, label = padj_t),y = y_text,  inherit.aes = F, size = 3) + 
    xlab("") + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(NA, y_text))
  return(p1)
}
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
p0 = DimPlot(sd1, label=T, group.by="cluster_label") + NoLegend()
p1 = FeaturePlot(sd1, "Pdx1", order=T, max.cutoff = "q90")
p2 = DotPlot(sd1, "Pdx1", group.by="cluster_label")
plot_grid(p0,p1,p2, nrow = 1, ncol=3 )
dev.off()
```
